NONE: › used to refer to two glands situated above the kidneys (the adrenal glands)
腎上的；腎旁的；腎上腺的
› the outer part of the adrenal gland
腎上腺皮質
› one of a pair of glands that produce adrenalin, found just above the kidneys
腎上腺（腎臟上方製造腎上腺素的一對腺體）
› the inner part of the adrenal gland that produces adrenaline
腎上腺髓質
› an operation to remove the adrenal gland, often because of a tumour
腎上腺切除（術）
› a hormone produced by the body, for example when you are frightened, angry, or excited, that makes the heart beat faster and prepares the body to react to danger
腎上腺素

example: These arguments always get my adrenalin going (= make me excited or angry).
這些爭論總是讓我腎上腺素上升（讓我激動或惱怒）。

NONE: › relating to the adrenal cortex (= the outer part of the adrenal gland)
腎上腺皮質的
› a rare genetic disease that increases the amount of a particular type of fatty acid in the brain and adrenal glands, affecting their normal activity
大腦白質退化症；腎上腺白質退化症；腎上腺腦白質失養症
› If a boat is adrift, it is moving on the water but is not controlled by anyone because of a problem.
漂浮的；漂流的
› If a person is adrift, they do not have a clear purpose in life or know what they want to do.
隨波逐流的；漫無目的的；漂泊無依的
› to become loose
脫開；鬆開
› If plans go adrift, they fail or do not produce the correct results.
出問題；出岔子

example: He spent three days adrift on his yacht.
他在遊艇上漂流了三天。
Da Silva plays a bright, lonely student from New York, adrift in small-town Arizona.
達席爾瓦飾演的角色是一個才華橫溢的學生，離開紐約孤身漂泊在偏僻的亞利桑那州。
The hem of my skirt's come adrift again.
我的裙子褶邊又散開了。
Something seems to have gone adrift in our calculations.
我們的計算好像有甚麼地方出了問題。

NONE: › very skilful and quick in the way you think or move
精明的；幹練的；機敏的；靈巧的

example: an adroit reaction/answer/movement of the hand
敏捷的反應／機敏的回答／靈巧的手部動作
She became adroit at dealing with difficult questions.
她變得非常善於處理棘手問題。
